title: Whispering Whelk Wizard
statement: A pearly, spiral-shelled sea snail who hums softly as he drifts through a tank of moonlit teal water, drawing slow glowing runes in the sand with his foot while tiny bioluminescent plankton gather to watch. He keeps his tower of stacked pebbles and a lantern-shaped anemone at the center of the glass, and every so often he pauses, tips his shell toward the visitors, and releases a single wobbling bubble that holds a secret.
